notes: Settings grew up: it's now the gear icon in the top bar — always there, on every page in Practice AND Studio, opening in place (no page shuffle) and toggling back to where you were. Inside, a proper control center with sections: Appearance (theme + NEW accent colors — amber, teal, violet, coral, recoloring the whole app including the logo), Sound (NEW master volume knob over everything + guitar/piano/bass voices), Studio (NEW retro-capture memory length 15/30/60s + idea playback voice: saw/pad/keys/bass), Screen & battery (NEW keep-awake toggle), and About with a check-for-updates button.
